name: Whipsaw Range Trade
setup: Price is trapped between two opposing GEX nodes of roughly equal absolute strength (within 10-15% magnitude). Example: -75M node at 6485 vs -80M node at 6500. Price ping-pongs between them.
entry: Short at the upper node, long at the lower node. Use limit orders only — lowball the bid by $0.10-$0.20. Enter on red candles into floor, green candles into ceiling. Never use market orders.
exit: Sell into the opposing node. Do NOT hold for breakout. Scale partials at the first Gatekeeper node encountered.
probability: ~66% probability of holding on tests 1 and 2. 3rd test has significantly higher probability of breaking through.
key_rules: Absolute Value Rule: sign matters less than magnitude (-80M > +20M)
Plus/Minus 5: allow ±5 point (SPX) variance before declaring trade failed
Liquidity Hunt: price often hunts 3-5 points below node before reversal
Size is Stop: no hard stops on 0DTE — position size is risk management
edge_cases: If one node's magnitude grows while the other shrinks, the range is breaking
V-Shape Liquidity Hunt: break below node but node value INCREASES = fakeout, enter reversal
